quotes.text: evaluator correctness: whether the evaluator agent
exact agreement accounted for 83.3% of paired ratings overall, and 96.2% of paired ratings differed by no more than 1 point

parsed.rationale: The benchmark validates its own evaluator outputs: twelve clinicians double-scored 100 runs on six runtime aspects including evaluator correctness, with agreement figures reported. The figures are rating distributions and inter-annotator agreement rather than per-class evaluator error rates.
